create_conv_nd: create a 1D, 2D, or 3D convolution module by specifying dimensions and channel arguments
create_timestep_embedding: create sinusoidal timestep embeddings for diffusion model training with configurable dimension and max period
update_ema: update target model parameters using exponential moving average from source parameters with a configurable rate
zero_module: zero out all parameters of a PyTorch module and return the modified module
checkpoint: evaluate a function with gradient checkpointing to reduce memory usage at the expense of extra compute
